arms.name: Base-first parallel parts
arms.idea: One low-effort flat-colour call builds and renders a bare structural base plus a literal list of add-on parts; all part calls then run concurrently with the base source so they place against real geometry instead of plan dimensions.

arms.name: Parallel flat parts with box check
arms.idea: The existing parflat arm with its plan and concurrent parts, plus the measured box check; no even-plan prompt.
